title.zh: 延长宿务省1905年身份证税和土地税的缴纳期限，并向该省提供60000比索贷款的法案
title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE CEDULA AND LAND TAXES IN THE PROVINCE OF CEBU FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE, AND PROVIDING FOR A LOAN OF SIXTY THOUSAND PESOS TO SAID PROVINCE.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE CEDULA AND LAND TAXES IN THE PROVINCE OF CEBU FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE, AND PROVIDING FOR A LOAN OF SIXTY THOUSAND PESOS TO SAID PROVINCE.
title.vi: Đạo luật gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế cedula và thuế đất năm 1905 tại tỉnh Cebu, đồng thời cho tỉnh vay 60.000 peso
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติขยายเวลาชำระภาษี cedula และภาษีที่ดินปี1905ในจังหวัด Cebu และให้เงินกู้แก่จังหวัดจำนวน60,000เปโซ
title.id: Undang-Undang yang memperpanjang batas pembayaran pajak cedula dan pajak tanah tahun 1905 di Provinsi Cebu serta memberikan pinjaman 60.000 peso kepada provinsi tersebut
title.ms: Akta yang melanjutkan tempoh pembayaran cukai cedula dan cukai tanah tahun 1905 di Wilayah Cebu serta memberikan pinjaman 60,000 peso kepada wilayah tersebut

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The period for the payment, without penalty, of the cedula tax for the year nineteen hundred and
live in the Province of Cebu is hereby extended to October thirty-first, nineteen hundred and five, the
provisions of Article XII of the Internal Revenue Law of Nineteen hundred and four to the contrary
notwithstanding, and the time for the payment, without penalty, of the hind tax for said year in said province
is hereby extended to November thirtieth, nineteen hundred and live.

There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of sixty thousand pesos, Philippine currency, to be loaned to the Province of Cebu and to be used by
the provincial board of said province in making loans to municipalities thereof for expenditure on public
works. Said amount shall be paid to the provincial treasurer of Cebu upon the production by him to the
Insular Treasurer of a certificate copy of a resolution of the provincial board of Cebu accepting such loan and
agreeing to repay the same, without interest, in four equal annual installments due on or before one, two,
three, and four years, respectively, from the date of the acceptance of said loan.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 5, 1905.
